recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Domain Models & Enums
recommended_phases.rationale: Pure domain types with zero dependencies. These are the foundation every other module builds on. Must come first.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Repository Interfaces & Implementations
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on Phase 1 models and the shared DB connection. Provides data-access contracts that services will consume.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Infrastructure Services (Audit & Notification)
recommended_phases.rationale: Cross-cutting services with no domain dependencies. Needed by Phase 4 business services. Audit satisfies GP-002; notification is a supporting concern.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — Business Services (Leave & Balance)
recommended_phases.rationale: Orchestrates repositories, audit, notification, and policy. Contains all business rules: balance validation, policy enforcement, status transitions.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — Routes & Controllers
recommended_phases.rationale: Fastify route registration with RBAC guards (GP-005) and input validation (GP-003). Depends on both business services.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: presentation (leave-routes), application (leave-service, balance-service), domain (leave-request, leave-balance, leave-policy, leave-type, leave-status), infrastructure (leave-repository, balance-repository, policy-repository, audit-service, notification-service). Dependencies flow inward only. Every public service method is defined in an interface before implementation. No circular dependencies. All state-changing operations go through IAuditService (GP-002). Routes enforce RBAC (GP-005) and validate inputs (GP-003). All DB access is through repository interfaces (GP-001).
